subject.title: [Bug]: Tool stdout leaks to chat + reply generation interrupted

question: Should external channel delivery suppress internal script/tool stdout by default, and which replay-unsafe post-tool incomplete turns may be retried without duplicating side effects?
rationale: The stdout half crosses a user-visible security/debug boundary, while the final-response half crosses replay-safety policy for side-effectful tools; automation should not choose either product boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define stdout boundary and track replay separately
options.body: Keep this issue open for stdout visibility policy while treating replay-unsafe post-tool recovery as owned by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88657.

options.title: Split into two issues
options.body: Create or keep a focused stdout-leak issue, then move the final-response half entirely to the canonical replay-unsafe incomplete-turn issue.

options.title: Document current debug behavior
options.body: If maintainers intentionally allow verbose/tool stdout in trusted chats, document that boundary and close only after the reporter-visible WeChat behavior is explained.

recommendation.title: Define stdout boundary and track replay separately
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for stdout visibility policy while treating replay-unsafe post-tool recovery as owned by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88657.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected owner in recent history for verbose output behavior, incomplete-turn recovery merges, and the current post-tool reply fix.
